title: Which step can feedback repair?
hook: A toy revision line must notice, diagnose and correct errors in that order.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to locate when diagnostic information can improve a disclosed serial revision process

misconception: More comments necessarily produce more completed corrections regardless of where the process is constrained.
objective: Locate when diagnostic information can improve a disclosed serial revision process.
